commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+4' Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+3' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF).
90+1' Rafael Benitez has decided to make a change. Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) replaces Carlos Dotor.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The fouls committed statistics – 19:14.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergio Ruiz leaves the pitch and Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) comes on.
88' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

85' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
84' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo).
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF) for Lucas Boye.
82' Alexandre Medina has decided to substitute Ricard Sanchez and he is replaced by Jose Callejon (Granada CF).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF) comes onto the pitch so that Carlos Neva can be given a rest.
81' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) is able to continue to play.
80' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
80' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!
78' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
76' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
75' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Celta Vigo earn a corner.
75' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
73' One of the players from Celta Vigo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
72' That will be all from Jonathan Bamba who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
72' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) replacing Jorgen Strand Larsen.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) is coming onto the pitch as Gonzalo Villar cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
68' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) commits a rough foul. Jose Sanchez stops the game and makes a call.
68' The resulting corner from Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
66' Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
66' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
65' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
65' The game is interrupted now, Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

64' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
64' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Vicente Guaita anticipates well and smothers the ball.
62' Substitution. Kevin Vazquez will be replaced by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo).
59' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
58' A cross by Carlos Neva (Granada CF) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
57' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
56' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
55' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Granada CF.
54' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
52' Granada CF are seeing far more of the ball now.
49' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) trips an opposition player and Jose Sanchez signals a foul. Celta Vigo are awarded the free kick.
48' The attendance for today's match is 18027.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Jose Sanchez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
45+1' The resulting corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
42' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Ferreira comes off his line to gather the ball.

42' The free kick from long range, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Chance! Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Andre Ferreira is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
41' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) brings an opponent down and Jose Sanchez interrupts the game. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick.

37' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) decides to try his luck with a first-time bullet of a shot. Unfortunately for him, he doesn't hit the ball perfectly and his effort ends well wide of the left post.
37' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner which is cleared.
36' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
36' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vicente Guaita, who smothers the ball.
35' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
31' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
29' What was Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
27' 7:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. 3:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
25' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
24' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
24' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Granada CF.
22' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is cautioned by the referee.
20' Goal - 1:0. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is first to the rebound and finds the back of the net with a brilliant back-heel finish.
20' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
20' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
17' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

17' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the left side of the goal, but Vicente Guaita pulls off a decent save to deny him.
16' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Granada CF earn a free kick.
14' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) latches onto the free kick from Iago Aspas, but heads just wide of the left post from close range.
12' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.

10' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Andre Ferreira pulls off an easy save.

9' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. Wasted opportunity. Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.

8' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jose Sanchez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. There is a free kick near the sideline to Celta Vigo.
6' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
6' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul. Granada CF have a free kick.
4' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
1' Iago Aspas races towards the box before laying off to Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
